implementation.optional: React or Next.js host; WebGPU/WGSL experimental after parity QA
implementation.fallback: 2D semantic document + labeled static rendering + captions

appearance.visual_intent: neutral instrumented inspection stage emphasizing material response, not an overly dramatic editorial render
appearance.colorspace: linear-light shading; named display transform and documented exposure
appearance.annotations: DOM text linked to stable specimen IDs; hide none behind mouse-only gestures

lighting.state_preservation: same light positions and exposure when comparing shader candidates

event_sequence.effect: Display semantic summary and static/GPU preview
Select specimen and announce the associated document anchor

state_invariants: object data does not depend on display frame rate
behavior.failure: Preserve interaction and documentation when WebGL context is lost or unavailable

simulation.clock: simulation dt fixed or clamped, decoupled from RAF timing
simulation.ambient: off by default in mobile low-power/reduced-motion; explicit opt-in on desktop
simulation.camera: user-driven orbit; no unannounced automatic navigation

reduced_motion: turn off ambient oscillation and automatic camera fly-throughs
replace nonessential transitions with instantaneous or low-motion state change
preserve access to each narrative cue in static text

performance_budget.classification: candidate thresholds, NOT benchmark results; tune after canary measurement

mobile_reference.conditions: document real device, resolution, DPR, browser, thermal state; this is not a universal mobile cap

desktop_reference.conditions: document representative GPU/browser and pixel ratio; thresholds are aspirational

quality_ladders: DPR clamp before reducing semantic content
use lower resolution normal maps/HDR prefilters
reduce particle count and volumetric steps
test: report p50/p95 frame time, dropped frames, draw calls, GPU allocations if observable, JS heap and context-loss recovery
test reduced motion, touch, keyboard, screen-reader text, WebGL unavailable and 320px viewport
performance_budget.approval_rule: no numeric budget moves from proposal to enforced gate before representative measurements and exception review

provenance.status: existing microsite-specific standard, not a universal 3D requirement
proposed ADR, not approved universal behavior

provenance.source: Stanton et al. 2017 dual-mode web UI study
Winchester et al. 2025 virtual storytelling case
provenance.status: external source: event workflow and camera constraints
